Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of JNJ.
Operating income reached $6.3 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 101 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2021.
We generated $7.2 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $6.01 per share.
Second question - Analyst:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
